page_title: WOL 1-1 FUL | Wolves v Fulham 17/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Andre (Wolves) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Thomas Kirk ignores the protests.
90+3' A pass from Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) is intercepted by Bernd Leno and the move breaks down.
90+2' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) unleashes a powerful shot from the free kick but it only hits the defensive wall.
90+1' Andre (Wolves) makes a rough challenge and Thomas Kirk blows his whistle for a foul. Fulham win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' That's unlucky! Kevin (Fulham) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.

88' Harry Wilson (Fulham) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
87' Kevin (Fulham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
85' David Moller Wolfe is being substituted because of an injury. Rob Edwards sends Hugo Bueno (Wolves) on the pitch.
85' Rob Edwards has decided to substitute Rodrigo Gomes and he is replaced by Pedro Lima (Wolves).
84' David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

82' Harry Wilson (Fulham) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.

81' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
80' The foul by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) was seen by Thomas Kirk who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
79' Substitution. Hee-Chan Hwang walks off the pitch and Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) comes on as a substitute.
79' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) replacing Oscar Bobb.
79' Substitution. Harry Wilson (Fulham) on for Emile Smith Rowe.
77' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) is caught offside!
75' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

74' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
73' David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Thomas Kirk blows his whistle for a foul.
72' That's the end of the game for Adam Armstrong, who is replaced by Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves).
70' The attendance is 28709.

70' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
69' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Thomas Kirk blows his whistle for a foul.

68' Adam Armstrong (Wolves) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the left post and flies out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
67' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Alex Iwobi will be replaced by Joshua King (Fulham).
67' It is time for a substitution. Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is on for Rodrigo Muniz.
66' Mateus Mane (Wolves) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
65' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
62' Oscar Bobb (Fulham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
61' The referee blows his whistle as Andre (Wolves) was too aggressive in his challenge.
59' Oscar Bobb (Fulham) attempts to curl the ball over the wall from the free kick, but one of the defenders deflects it away from danger.

58' Andre (Wolves) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Thomas Kirk with no other option than to blow for a foul. Fulham are awarded a free kick.
56' Oscar Bobb (Fulham) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
55' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.

54' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) attempts to put in the resulting set piece, but he miskicks and sends the ball into the stands. A strong but inaccurate shot. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
53' Thomas Kirk blows for a foul after Sasa Lukic (Fulham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Wolves get a free kick.

52' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
52' It will be a corner kick for Wolves.
52' David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for Wolves.
51' Kevin (Fulham) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
50' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Thomas Kirk blows for a foul.
48' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but Jose Sa comes off his line to gather the ball.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Marco Silva gives a chance to Kevin (Fulham) and Sander Berge is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Mateus Mane (Wolves) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
45+3' 1 - 1 Goal! Antonee Robinson (Fulham) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Jose Sa to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
45+3' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is going to take the penalty!
45+2' It’s a PENALTY to Fulham after the VAR review!
45+1' Referee Thomas Kirk makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Fulham. Let’s see what happens!
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
45' Sander Berge (Fulham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
44' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
42' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

41' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Jose Sa pulls off a brilliant save.
40' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
38' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
38' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Fulham are going to take it.
37' Mateus Mane (Wolves) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
36' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) commits a rough challenge and Thomas Kirk blows his whistle for an infringement.

34' Oscar Bobb sprays a pass out to Timothy Castagne (Fulham), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
33' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.

31' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
31' Sander Berge (Fulham) makes a strong challenge and Thomas Kirk blows for a foul. Wolves have been awarded a free kick.

29' Sander Berge (Fulham) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
29' The ball is out of play. Fulham win a corner kick.
28' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Sasa Lukic (Fulham).

28' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The linesman makes the right call and Fulham will have a corner.
25' 1 - 0 Goal! Mateus Mane (Wolves) is teed up on the edge of the box by Hee-Chan Hwang, and his howitzer of a shot inside the left post gives the keeper no chance. 1:0.

25' The opposition can't get near Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the left post at the last second. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.

24' The cross into the penalty area from Timothy Castagne (Fulham) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
23' The ball is cleared after Oscar Bobb (Fulham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
20' A rebound falls at the feet of Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) on the edge of the box, but his powerful shot veers well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
17' Mateus Mane (Wolves) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Bernd Leno sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.
15' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
15' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Fulham win a corner.
13' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the bottom left corner, but Jose Sa is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
11' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
9' Mateus Mane (Wolves) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
8' David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Wolves.
8' Mateus Mane (Wolves) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
7' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
4' A crossfield pass from Calvin Bassey (Fulham) fails to find any of his teammates.
2' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
1' The first half has just begun.
Fulham will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Thomas Kirk.
